event.proposal: Family: training control. Retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100.00%, a 1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Most recent same-family result is attempt-0001, an optimization failure at ff=32 with 1000 steps; prior attempts in this family: 1. This trial uses the distinct 2-step budget in the bounded ordinal sweep to separate low-budget failure from architecture evidence; it is more informative than repeating 1000 steps because it samples the adjacent lower-budget condition. Candidate changes are training-control only; acceptance remains official qualification plus strictly fewer parameters, and rollback is runner-managed.
